annotations.title: Hours of Operation | Glenwood Hot Springs Resort

content.text:
Which **Glenwood Pool** do you mean? There are several.

Most likely options:

- **Glenwood Recreation Club / Glenwood Pool** — Forest Glen, Silver Spring, MD  
  **Address:** 10012 Gardiner Ave, Silver Spring, MD 20902  
  **Phone:** 301-681-7599  
  Today’s season period is **Early Summer, May 23–June 18, 2026**; Monday hours are **3:30–7:45 p.m.** ([glenwoodpool.org](https://glenwoodpool.org/about/hours/?utm_source=openai))

- **Glenwood Hot Springs Pool** — Glenwood Springs, CO  
  **Address:** 415 East 6th Street, Glenwood Springs, CO 81601  
  **Hours:** Daily **8:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.** ([hotspringspool.com](https://hotspringspool.com/home-page/hours-of-operation/?utm_source=openai))

- **Glenwood Park Pool** — Atlanta, GA  
  **Address:** 943 North Ormewood Park Drive SE, Atlanta, GA 30316  
  **Hours:** **6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. daily** ([glenwoodpark.com](https://www.glenwoodpark.com/info/26453?utm_source=openai))

If you tell me the **city/state**, I can give you the exact hours, address, admission/membership info, and directions.
